# Best slim Qi2 power banks for iPhone 17

**Best overall slim pick: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim), $54.99**
- It's 0.34 in thick and 4.3 oz (122 g), with 15 W Qi2 wireless charging and 5,000 mAh. 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than competitors.
- [Buy at Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank). The page showed a $5 auto-applied discount ending soon, so check the price at checkout.
- Source: [Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)

**Best slim with more capacity and faster charging: Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh), $59.99**
- It does 25 W Qi2.2 wireless on the iPhone 16 and 17 (iOS 26) and 45 W wired over USB-C.
- Dealectric lists a $6 discount with code **AM52**, bringing it to $53.99 at Baseus's US store. They tested it on 2026-10-24, but checkout has the final word.
- The results don't give its thickness, so I can't say how slim it is.
- [Buy at Baseus via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
- Source: [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w)

**Slimmest 10K options with 25 W charging: INIU SnapGo Air, Ugreen MagFlow Pro**
- Macworld lists the INIU 25W SnapGo Air 10K and Ugreen MagFlow Pro 10K as the equal slimmest 10K MagSafe packs it tested. Android Central lists the INIU at $54.99, 0.5 in thick and 195 g, with 25 W wireless and 45 W wired charging.
- The results had no direct purchase links for these, so check the deal links in the reviews: [Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html), [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge).

**Skip if you want fast wireless charging: Baseus PicoGo Air AM71**
- It's very thin (0.27 in, 104 g), but wireless charging tops out at 7.5 W, and Android Central lists it at $69.99. That's poor value next to the Anker.

**How to choose**
- **Thinnest and lightest, for a top-up:** Anker Nano 5K.
- **A fuller recharge and faster wireless charging, with a bit more thickness:** a 10K pack with 25 W Qi2.2, such as the Baseus AM52 or INIU SnapGo Air.
- The iPhone 17 can use the 25 W speeds, but the 16e can't.

I couldn't open the pages, so prices and codes are as of the search results and may have changed.
